name: L10-PanoLab official viewer-equivalent effective-zero projection
question: Can the official Panoramax viewer's effective-zero pose semantics unlock independent collections that the explicit-zero metadata gate could not evaluate?
information_change: Replace the explicit-field requirement with the exact effective pose resolved by Panoramax web-viewer 5.2.0. Keep full 360-degree 2:1 pixels, true-north native heading, view-azimuth agreement, full-sensor visibility and equirectangular projection unchanged.

frozen_semantics: getSphereCorrection resolves pers:yaw, pers:pitch and pers:roll through their documented EXIF fallbacks
each still-unresolved pose component defaults to zero
for a 360-degree image sphere correction is empty unless both effective pitch and roll are non-zero

retained_baseline_requirements: view:azimuth and GPSImgDirection circular difference <=1 degree
admission.effective_pose_rule: Resolve STAC pose first, then the exact official EXIF fallback order, then zero. Admit only when all three effective components are zero.

frozen_comparison.primary: viewer-equivalent eligible cross-collection DIRECT target ways
frozen_comparison.counterfactual: same target/item roster under the prior strict explicit-zero gate

stop_condition: Run one federated metadata discovery and one role-separated pixel admission on a frozen cohort. Do not tune heading tolerance, distance, matcher, crop, backbone, tracker or portal truth after seeing outcomes.
claim_boundary: This contract authorizes only the raw-x projection used by the official viewer for effective-zero 360 imagery. It is not a physical camera-pose estimate, portal visibility, entrance ownership, access, traversability, waypoint, arrival, handoff, product, user-benefit or safety evidence.
